# Envy shortcuts reference

Every id below can be re-bound in the `[shortcuts]` table of
`~/.config/envy/config.md`:

```toml
[shortcuts]
jumpToSearch = "Ctrl+K"
```

An id you leave out keeps its default. An id that is not in this list is
reported by `envynote config check` and ignored.

## Chord grammar

A chord is modifiers then one key, joined by `+`, with no spaces. The
modifier order is fixed: `Ctrl`, then `Alt`, then `Shift`. Write them in
that order or the chord will never match, because Envy compares the
canonical string built by `eventToBinding` in `src/shortcuts.ts`.

The key itself is the browser `KeyboardEvent.key` name:

- A single letter is upper-cased, so `Ctrl+B`, never `Ctrl+b`. Shift is a
  separate part, so bold with Shift is `Ctrl+Shift+B`.
- Digits and punctuation are the character itself: `Ctrl+0`, `Ctrl+,`,
  `Ctrl+/`, `Ctrl+=`, `Ctrl+-`.
- Named keys keep their `KeyboardEvent.key` spelling: `Enter`, `Escape`,
  `Tab`, `Backspace`, `Delete`, `Home`, `End`, `PageUp`, `PageDown`,
  `ArrowUp`, `ArrowDown`, `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight`, `F1` to `F12`.
- The space bar is written `Space`.

There is no `Meta` or `Super` modifier. Envy never builds one, so a chord
containing it can never match, and the Super key belongs to the compositor
anyway. For a Super chord, add a Hyprland bind instead.

Write the long arrow names in the file. Envy shortens them to `Down`,
`Up`, `Left` and `Right` for display only, so `Ctrl+Alt+Down` in the file
is a chord that can never fire.

Two actions bound to the same chord is a conflict: only one of them can
ever run, and Envy flags it in Settings. Check the table before picking a
chord.

## Global shortcuts

These are meant to work from any app. On Wayland no app can register a
global hotkey, so on Omarchy and Hyprland the chord in the config file is
not what fires them: a Hyprland bind is. `linux/hyprland-envy.lua` binds
`CTRL + ALT + RETURN` to `envy-summon.sh`, which runs `envynote --toggle`
over the control socket. That file is loaded by one line in
`~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua`, which `system.hyprland_bind = true` in
config.md adds (and `false` removes) — see settings.md. To change the
summon chord, edit the Hyprland bind (see the `omarchy` skill) and not
this table. The entries here still matter on X11 and for a future portal
backend.

| Id | What it does | Default chord |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `summonApp` | Show/Hide Envy (works from any app) | `Ctrl+Alt+Enter` |
| `showPinnedNote` | Show/Hide Pinned Note (works from any app) | `Ctrl+Alt+ArrowDown` |
| `unpinFromTray` | Unpin Note from Tray (works from any app) | `Ctrl+Alt+Shift+P` |
| `keepOnTop` | Keep Envy on Top (works from any app) | `Ctrl+Alt+Shift+T` |

## Editor shortcuts

Handled inside the editor, so they only fire while the note has focus.

| Id | What it does | Default chord |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `extractToNote` | Extract Selection to New Note | `Ctrl+Alt+N` |
| `bold` | Bold | `Ctrl+B` |
| `italic` | Italic | `Ctrl+I` |

## Window shortcuts

Handled by the window, so they fire wherever focus is inside Envy.

| Id | What it does | Default chord |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `jumpToSearch` | Jump to Search | `Escape` |
| `clearSearch` | Clear Search | `Alt+Backspace` |
| `newFromTemplate` | New Note from Template | `Ctrl+Shift+N` |
| `insertImage` | Insert Image | `Ctrl+Alt+I` |
| `insertTable` | Insert Table | `Ctrl+Shift+T` |
| `deleteNote` | Delete Note | `Ctrl+Backspace` |
| `restoreDeletedNote` | Restore Deleted Note | `Ctrl+Shift+Backspace` |
| `togglePin` | Pin/Unpin Note | `Ctrl+Alt+P` |
| `pinToTray` | Pin Note to Tray | `Ctrl+Alt+T` |
| `toggleLayout` | Toggle Layout | `Ctrl+Shift+L` |
| `toggleInterlinks` | Toggle Interlinks | `Ctrl+Shift+B` |
| `togglePlainTextMode` | Toggle Plain-Text Mode | `Ctrl+Shift+P` |
| `centerWindow` | Center Window | `Ctrl+Enter` |
| `openSettings` | Settings | `Ctrl+,` |
| `focusNextArea` | Focus Next Area | `Alt+ArrowDown` |
| `focusPreviousArea` | Focus Previous Area | `Alt+ArrowUp` |
| `followLink` | Follow Link Under Cursor | `Ctrl+Shift+Enter` |
| `peekLink` | Peek at Link Under Cursor | `Alt+Enter` |
| `toggleCheckbox` | Toggle Checkbox | `Ctrl+Shift+D` |
| `retireDue` | Retire/Restore Due Date | `Ctrl+Shift+U` |
| `emojiForLink` | Emoji for Link | `Ctrl+Shift+E` |
| `popOut` | Pop Out Note | `Ctrl+Shift+O` |
| `toggleSplit` | Split Editor / Close Split | `Ctrl+\` |
| `switchPane` | Switch Editor Pane | `Alt+\` |
| `flipSplit` | Flip Split Direction | `Ctrl+Alt+\` |
| `moveToFolder` | Move to Folder… | `Ctrl+Shift+M` |
| `toggleHelp` | Markup Help | `Ctrl+/` |
| `zoomIn` | Zoom In | `Ctrl+=` |
| `zoomOut` | Zoom Out | `Ctrl+-` |
| `actualSize` | Actual Size | `Ctrl+0` |

## Worked example

Move Jump to Search onto Ctrl+K and put the layout toggle on F6:

```toml
[shortcuts]
jumpToSearch = "Ctrl+K"
toggleLayout = "F6"
```

Then `envynote config check`. The change applies to the running app.
